title: Book Trailer Winner
content: Congratulations toJared Updike, who was voted the winner of theColor and Lightvideo contest by the reader poll at left.  Jared will receive the actual book  that appears in the “Painting  Rainbows video” plus another book of his choice.And thanks to all the other entrants: Ana, Roger, Eric, and Christian, each of whom will receive a free signed book from theDinotopia Store. And thanks to all of you who voted!------Order"Color and Light" from Amazon.See all five entrants to the contest.
